Foundations of Graphic Design
This introductory course explores core design principles,
color theory, layout techniques, and basics of
industry software.
Open to first-year students and art majors.
Classes meet Tuesdays and Thursdays, 3–4 P.M., at the
College Design Studio.
This course is offered only in the fall semester.
